paper_title: Repeated rectal application of a hyperosmolar lubricant is associated with microbiota shifts but does not affect PrEP drug concentrations: results from a randomized trial in men who have sex with men

pico.patient: men who have sex with men
pico.intervention: hyperosmolar rectal lubricant + tenofovir disoproxil fumarate plus emtricitabine
pico.outcome: PrEP drug concentrations in rectal tissue and secretions were not associated with microbiota composition or diversity either before or after lubricant use.

n.group_name: hyperosmolar rectal lubricant + tenofovir disoproxil fumarate plus emtricitabine
